items.title: Meta Ads: $48.89 spend, 3 leads, $16.30 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Yesterday (2026-09-02) Meta spent $48.89, all on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 3 leads at $16.30 CPL. That's below the 7-day baseline (2026-08-27 to 2026-09-02: $345.37 / 18 leads, ~$19.19 CPL), so no CPL anomaly. Account is ACTIVE, currency CAD, and no ads are flagged DISAPPROVED or WITH_ISSUES.

needs_attention: Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 3, matching the counted leads exactly, same recurrence flagged on 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-02). No discrepancy in the counted total, but the script's lead-action set should be reviewed for extension rather than continuing to hand-note it each run.
